items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch, rights-dependent monetization, and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible work preserving consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, age-sensitive, and data-handling boundaries. Exact decision: keep searchwoot.com private, keep Woot permission outreach unsent, and continue existing read-only evidence work only. Evidence: Woot public terms do not establish public/commercial redistribution rights; all four launch tasks remain open; accuracy/freshness, measurement/attribution, and security gates are blocked; compliance is technical-only with 37 pass, 15 fail, and 7 unknown. Incomplete telemetry alone does not block ordinary growth. Human counsel is required for Woot rights, jurisdictional privacy/consent treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. No task is closable on current evidence. Progress is limited to partial official-source, repository/configuration, privacy-policy, and cookie-policy evidence. Open tasks: searchwoot-legal-source-rights, searchwoot-data-flow-retention, searchwoot-ga4-consent-evidence, and searchwoot-logs-vendors-incident. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage, caching, display, derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor coverage, and incident/request procedures. Close no task without attached evidence.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required because rights to fetch, store, transform, display, cache, retain historical derivatives, send alerts, use trademarks/images/prices, or monetize through affiliates or advertising are not evidenced. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed because data inventory, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior are incomplete. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed because deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional treatment are not evidenced. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed because log fields, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA coverage, incident handling, and data-request procedures are incomplete. Smallest next actions: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review; produce the repository/deployed data-flow and retention table; capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking or advertising; and produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory with counsel-required gaps.

Site-specific compliance decision: retain complicated.work parked because it is reachable but fails banner, consent accept/reject, and GA4 checks. Retain deadlymaracas.com parked because DNS reachability fails and compliance status is unknown. Require a concrete reachability, consent/banner, privacy/terms, analytics, monetization, and release checklist before either launch decision. Ordinary reversible growth may continue elsewhere only when the specific change preserves existing disclosures, consent, affiliate disclosure, provenance and rights, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Do not infer regulated, adult, or age-sensitive status from domain names. Preserve the $4.92 provider aggregate as unattributed and make no revenue, ROI, margin, payback, or causal-lift claims.
